row:
POST TIME is a half-hour weekly television program that promotes harness racing at Bally's Dover, Harrington Raceway and Ocean Downs. The show airs on Delmarva Sports Network on Sunday Mornings at 8 am & 11:30 am. 
Our first POST TIME half-hour show aired in July of 1998. We've had a new show each week, which means that there have been over 1,300 "Post Time" episodes! WOW! 
Find out more about "Post Time" and the Delaware Standardbred Owners Association at www.dsoaonline.com!
